meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查 Codex 命令行工具的安装状态,找出过期、走样或损坏的配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 Codex 安装后行为异常,想确认本地环境是否需要更新或修复
copy.tagline_en: Health-check your Codex CLI install and flag stale, drifted, or broken setups
copy.fit_line_en: For you if Codex acts up after an install or update and you want your local setup audited

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 变成 LazyCodex 安装诊断医生:拉取最新 LazyCodex 与 Codex 源码,检查本地安装、配置、插件载荷和命令行,输出 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告,每条结论都附命令输出或文件证据。诊断期间不改你的安装和配置,只给修复建议。
howto.when: 当你要求做 doctor 或健康检查、提到 LazyCodex 等关键词,或 Codex 在安装、更新、改配置后行为异常、怀疑安装过期损坏时触发。

say.text: 帮我跑一次 LazyCodex doctor,看安装有没有问题
say.note: 会同步源码并给出 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告

say.text: Codex 更新后行为怪怪的,帮我查是不是配置漂移
say.note: 对比最新源码找漂移并给出修复命令

say.text: 检查我的 Codex CLI 版本够不够用,Astra 模型能不能用

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a LazyCodex install doctor: it syncs the latest LazyCodex and Codex sources, inspects your local install, config and plugin payload, then returns a PASS/WARN/FAIL report where every verdict cites command output or a file.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a doctor or health check, mention LazyCodex and similar keywords, or Codex misbehaves after an install, update or config change.

say_en.text: Run a LazyCodex doctor and tell me if my install is healthy
say_en.note: Syncs sources and returns a PASS/WARN/FAIL report

say_en.text: Codex behaves oddly after updating - check for config drift
say_en.note: Compares against latest sources and gives fixes

say_en.text: Is my Codex CLI new enough for the Astra model?
